Metadata.title: Ability Portal
Metadata.description: One entry point for Ability Tech products.

Home.title: Choose a <highlight>product</highlight>
Home.intro: Open the Ability Tech product you want to work in.
Home.configurationPendingDescription: The address of this product has not been set up for this portal yet.
Home.unavailableDescription: Contact Ability Tech if you need {product}.
Home.accessCheckFailedDescription: The sign-in service didn’t answer, so no product can be opened right now. Try again in a moment.

Auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
Auth.tooManyAttemptsLater: Too many attempts. Try again later.
Auth.unavailable: The sign-in service isn’t available right now. Try again in a moment.

errors.email_invalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

SignIn.title: Sign in to your <highlight>portal</highlight>
SignIn.intro: Use the email address and password of your Ability Tech account.
SignIn.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
SignIn.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact Ability Tech.
SignIn.noAccount: Ability Tech creates the accounts of its clients. If you don’t have one yet, contact Ability Tech.

notices.session-ended: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
notices.password-set: Your password is set. Sign in with your new password.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your <highlight>password</highlight>
ForgotPassword.intro: We’ll email you a link to set a new password.
ForgotPassword.emailHint: The email address you sign in with.
ForgotPassword.sentDescription: If an account uses <email>{address}</email>, we’ve sent it a link to set a new password. The link works once and expires after a short time.

SetPassword.title: Set your <highlight>password</highlight>
SetPassword.intro: Choose the password you’ll use to sign in to Ability Portal.
SetPassword.linkMissing: Open this page from the link in your email. If the link no longer works, request a new one.
SetPassword.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
SetPassword.hint: At least {minLength} characters. A sentence you’ll remember works well.

errors.password_too_common: This password is too common or has appeared in a data breach. Choose another one.
errors.password_rejected: This password can’t be used. Choose another one.

crm.name: Ability CRM
crm.description: Customer relationship management for your organization.

communityAdmin.name: Community Admin
communityAdmin.description: Administration for your community mobile app.
